editorial:
Ray Owens used to be a big-city cop, but now he keeps the peace in a sleepy border town called Sommerton Junction. When a dangerous drug lord breaks free from FBI custody and races toward Mexico in a super-fast car, Ray and his small team are the last ones standing between him and freedom. The movie mixes big action with small-town charm, and you get a fun ride that never takes itself too seriously. Arnold Schwarzenegger plays Ray with a mix of toughness and dry humor, and the supporting cast keeps things lively.

The action scenes are loud and well-staged, especially the final showdown on the border bridge. The pacing stays quick, though some jokes land better than others and a few characters feel thin. If you want a simple, fun action movie with car chases and shootouts, this is a great pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Cortez reaches the border bridge in his modified Corvette, but Ray and his deputies have blocked the way with vehicles and gunfire. Ray shoots Cortez in the leg, stopping him just short of Mexico, and arrests him. The FBI arrives to take Cortez into custody. Ray is offered his old LAPD job back, but he chooses to stay in Sommerton Junction as sheriff.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school action movies and car chases.
